mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset_discovery_candidate ( node_id, file_path, file_name, file_type, size_bytes, checksum, last_modified_at, availability, last_seen_at ) VALUES ( #{nodeId}, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{checksum}, #{lastModifiedAt}, #{availability}, #{lastSeenAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE file_name = VALUES(file_name), file_type = VALUES(file_type), size_bytes = VALUES(size_bytes), checksum = VALUES(checksum), last_modified_at = VALUES(last_modified_at), availability = VALUES(availability), last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dataset_discovery_candidate WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} AND file_path = #{filePath}
SELECT * FROM registered_dataset WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM registered_dataset WHERE dataset_code = #{datasetCode} AND dataset_version = #{datasetVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE registered_dataset SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, data_type = #{dataType}, labels_json = #{labelsJson}, required_cpu = #{requiredCpu}, required_memory_gi = #{requiredMemoryGi}, required_gpu = #{requiredGpu}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND row_version = #{rowVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE registered_dataset SET status = #{status}, verification_message = #{verificationMessage}, verified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)verified_at, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE registered_dataset SET default_runtime_image_id = #{runtimeImageId}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE registered_dataset SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_management WHERE selected_data LIKE CONCAT('%', #{datasetName}, '%')
SELECT * FROM dataset_replica WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND node_id = #{nodeId} AND file_path = #{filePath}
SELECT * FROM dataset_replica WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} ORDER BY replica_id
mapper.update: UPDATE dataset_replica SET availability = #{availability}, verified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)verified_at WHERE replica_id = #{replicaId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset_replica WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND availability = 'AVAILABLE'
